title: A problem with the room
instructions: Bayan Clark otel resepsiyonuna şikâyete geliyor. Uzun bir diyalog; sorunları ve çözümleri eşleştir. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: clark
script.text: Excuse me. I'm in room three-oh-five, and I'm afraid there are some problems.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: I'm sorry to hear that. What's wrong?

script.speaker: clark
script.text: First, the air conditioning doesn't work. The room is very hot.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: I'll send someone to look at it right away.

script.speaker: clark
script.text: Also, I asked for a room with a sea view, but my window looks at the car park.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Let me check. You're right. I'm very sorry. We have a sea view room on the fifth floor, room five-twelve.

script.speaker: clark
script.text: Is the air conditioning OK in that room?

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Yes, it's a new room. And the air conditioning works perfectly.

script.speaker: clark
script.text: Good. And one more thing. There were no towels in the bathroom.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: I'm so sorry. There will be towels in your new room. And as we're sorry, breakfast is free for the rest of your stay.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Someone will help you with your bags in ten minutes.

questions.prompt: What was Mrs Clark's first room number?
What is the problem with the air conditioning?
questions.feedback: Klima çalışmıyor (doesn't work), oda çok sıcak.

questions.prompt: What can Mrs Clark see from her first room?
questions.feedback: Deniz manzarası istedi ama penceresi otoparka (car park) bakıyor.
questions.evidence: but my window looks at the car park.

questions.prompt: What does the hotel give her because of the problems?
questions.feedback: Özür olarak kalan günler kahvaltı bedava (breakfast is free).
questions.evidence: breakfast is free for the rest of your stay.

questions.prompt: What floor is her new room on?
questions.evidence: We have a sea view room on the fifth floor
